title: HighRiskReview
description: Independent reread results keyed by stable content ID. In the lite 1:1 profile file_id may equal source_id. sidecar_path records where the sidecar was reviewed; it is never the lookup key.

sidecar_path.description: Sidecar location at review time. Informational only; it may become stale after deterministic filing.

status.description: not_applicable is written only when the deterministic filter selected no high-risk field. passed_independent_reread asserts complete coverage of all selected fields. A partial review must use needs_human_review.
